texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information, visit abp.io.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxDurationMustBe: The longest booking allowed must be greater than zero minutes.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxHorizonDaysMus: How far ahead people can book must be greater than zero days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinLeadMinutesMus: The minimum notice before a booking can't be negative.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:InvalidOwnOverlap: Pick whether people may hold two bookings at once: allow, warn or block.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:TimezoneChangeWit: This building has {count} upcoming bookings, and changing its timezone would move every one of them to a different local time. The timezone can only change while nothing is booked ahead.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxSeriesHorizonT: Recurring bookings must be allowed at least as far ahead as single ones ({horizonDays} days).
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityMustBePos: Capacity must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityBelowMinA: Capacity ({capacity}) can't drop below the minimum group size ({minAttendees}) — lower the minimum first.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesMustB: The minimum group size must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesExcee: The minimum group size ({minAttendees}) can't exceed this space's capacity ({capacity}).
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:DaysNotNarrower: These operating days aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:HoursNotNarrower: These operating hours aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating hours.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:OverrideEndsAtMus: A closure's end time must be after its start time.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:ReasonDetailTooLo: The closure's reason detail is too long.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeNameAlre: A space type named '{name}' already exists.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeInUse: This space type is still assigned to one or more spaces and can't be deleted.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:ParentIsDeleted: This can't be restored while the {parent} it belongs to is deleted. Restore the {parent} first.
texts.Dixels:Users:InvalidBuildingId: The building id is not valid. Pick a building from the list.
texts.Dixels:TooManyRequests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAligned: Bookings start and end on {slotMinutes}-minute boundaries — pick times like 09:00, 09:15 or 09:30.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SpaceClosed: This space is closed from {from} to {until} ({level} closure: {reason}). Pick another time or another space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OverCapacity: This space seats {capacity}, but you asked for {attendees}. Reduce the attendees or pick a larger space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:BelowMinAttendees: This space needs at least {minAttendees} attendees ({level} rule), but you asked for {attendees}. Add attendees or pick a smaller space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:TooLong: Bookings here can last at most {maxDuration} ({level} rule), but you asked for {requested}. Shorten the booking.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:ClosedDay: This space isn't open on {day} ({level} rule — open {openDays}). Pick another day.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OutsideHours: This booking falls outside opening hours, {hours} ({level} rule). Move it inside those hours.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:BeyondHorizon: Bookings can be made up to {horizonDays} days ahead — the latest date is {lastDate}. Pick an earlier date.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:StartInPast: That start time has already passed. Pick a time in the future.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:TooSoon: Bookings need at least {leadMinutes} minutes' notice. Pick a later start time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:Overlap: This space is already booked for part of that time. Pick another time or another space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAligned:Short: Times must be on the {slotMinutes}-minute grid
texts.Dixels:Bookings:InvalidTimeRange: The end time must be after the start time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:AttendeesMustBePositive: A booking needs at least one attendee.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAssignedToBuilding: You can only book spaces in your assigned building. Ask an administrator to assign you to this building.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:IdempotencyKeyReused: This request was already submitted with different details. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotCancellable: This booking can't be cancelled because it is already {status}.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotYours: You can only cancel your own bookings.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:AlreadyStarted: This booking has already started, so it can't be cancelled.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:InvalidDateRange: Pick a date range of 1 to {maxDays} days, with the end after the start.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OwnOverlap: You already have {spaceName} booked {from}–{until}, and this building allows one booking at a time. Cancel that booking or pick another time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesInvalidRule: That repeat pattern isn't valid. Pick daily, weekly or monthly.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesNoWeekdays: Pick at least one day of the week to repeat on.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesEndBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the first booking.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesTooManyOccurrences: A series can have at most {max} bookings. Pick an earlier end date or repeat less often.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesBeyondHorizon: Recurring bookings can run up to {horizonDays} days ahead — the latest end date is {lastDate}.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesNothingToBook: Every date is unticked, so there's nothing to book.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesDateUnavailable: {date} was just taken or no longer fits the rules, so nothing was booked. Check the dates again and book the rest.
